entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: ¶Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: "Therefore my anxious thoughts make me answer, Because of the turmoil within me.

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I have heard the rebuke that reproaches me, And the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: "Do you [not] know this of old, Since man was placed on earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the hypocrite is [but] for a moment?

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though his haughtiness mounts up to the heavens, And his head reaches to the clouds,

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: [Yet] he will perish forever like his own refuse; Those who have seen him will say, 'Where is he?'

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He will fly away like a dream, and not be found; Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: The eye [that] saw him will [see him] no more, Nor will his place behold him anymore.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: ¶His children will seek the favor of the poor, And his hands will restore his wealth.

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones are full of his youthful vigor, But it will lie down with him in the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth, [And] he hides it under his tongue,

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: [Though] he spares it and does not forsake it, But still keeps it in his mouth,

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: [Yet] his food in his stomach turns sour; It becomes cobra venom within him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He swallows down riches And vomits them up again; God casts them out of his belly.

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He will suck the poison of cobras; The viper's tongue will slay him.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: He will not see the streams, The rivers flowing with honey and cream.

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: He will restore that for which he labored, And will not swallow [it] down; From the proceeds of business He will get no enjoyment.

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: For he has oppressed [and] forsaken the poor, He has violently seized a house which he did not build.

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: "Because he knows no quietness in his heart, He will not save anything he desires.

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: Nothing is left for him to eat; Therefore his well-being will not last.

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: In his self-sufficiency he will be in distress; Every hand of misery will come against him.

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: ¶[When] he is about to fill his stomach, [God] will cast on him the fury of His wrath, And will rain [it] on him while he is eating.

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: He will flee from the iron weapon; A bronze bow will pierce him through.

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: It is drawn, and comes out of the body; Yes, the glittering [point comes] out of his gall. Terrors [come] upon him;

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: Total darkness [is] reserved for his treasures. An unfanned fire will consume him; It shall go ill with him who is left in his tent.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heavens will reveal his iniquity, And the earth will rise up against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The increase of his house will depart, [And his goods] will flow away in the day of His wrath.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This [is] the portion from God for a wicked man, The heritage appointed to him by God."
